# Shelfwise PRD

Shelfwise is a lending desk for small neighborhood libraries run by volunteers. It is a fictional product used as a test fixture.

## Problem

Volunteers track loans on paper cards. Cards get lost, due dates are missed, and nobody can see at a glance which books are out.

## Lending

A volunteer records a loan in under ten seconds: borrower name, book title, and a due date that defaults to two weeks out.

## Loans list

Every open loan appears in one list, newest first, with the borrower, the title, and the due date. The list count updates the moment a loan is recorded.

## Out of scope

Payments, fines, catalog search, and member accounts.
